item.title: August Critique Group: Howard Bossen
item.description:
Sunday, August 9, 2026 at 2 PM

Location: 1441 W Alabama St, Houston, TX 77006

HCP Members are invited to join our August Critique Group led by Howard Bossen, Professor Emeritus of Photography and Visual Communication, School of Journalism at Michigan State University. You may register for free as a Presenter and get feedback on your work from Bossen and fellow HCP members, or as an Attendee and partake in the discussion. item.title: HCP Fall Open House (Online)
item.description:
Tuesday, August 25, 2026 at 6 PM

Location: Online via Zoom

Join us online on Tuesday, August 25, between 6-8 pm at our Fall 2026 Open House with guest speaker Patricia Voulgaris. Learn about new and upcoming courses, hands-on workshops, community events, and professional certificate programs. Have your work reviewed, and receive a free personal consultation from Natan Dvir and a 10% discount on Spring classes.RSVP is required via this link.
